verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stagehand can launch or attach a single browser via `browserbase.launch`, `localBrowser.launch` or a CDP connect, and that Browserbase offers regions and a session dashboard. Nothing documents running a fleet of concurrent sessions, any concurrency limits, or programmatic fleet-level session management. Launching one browser is a building block rather than the capability, and the dashboard and regions are Browserbase host-platform features, so neither earns credit.
